CustomField.description: This field will indicate if a contact's credit score has gone up or down or no change was present. This field is a formula and cannot be edited.
CustomField.formula: IF( FICO_Score__c > VALUE(OLD_CREDIT_SCORE__c) ,"UP", IF(FICO_Score__c < VALUE(OLD_CREDIT_SCORE__c) , "Down", IF(FICO_Score__c = VALUE(OLD_CREDIT_SCORE__c) , "No Change", IF( AND(OLD_CREDIT_SCORE__c = "", FICO_Score__c > 0) , "New Score", "No Score") ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will indicate if a contact's credit score has gone up or down or no change was present. This field is a formula and cannot be edited.
CustomField.label: Credit Score Direction
